mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at 65 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. The first quarter moon will provide some light for tonight's ISS pass, which begins at 9:15 PM, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast. The overnight low is 56 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is actively seeking new patrol officers for the team. Additionally, the city is continuing its work on the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide our growth over the next decade.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. You can also catch trivia tonight at Hop Haus, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, and the exciting Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ festival this Friday.
In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on September 5th, officers were dispatched after several vehicles were found with cheese slices left on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available right now. We look forward to them serving up delicious treats again soon.
